title: The Sovereign's Enemy
summary: Ha-Jun's return to Seoul rallies the human defenders. As the 50,000 Iron Demon Vanguard reinforces Gangnam, the true architect of the invasion emerges: Void General Xal'Khor.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing atop the dead 50-foot behemoth wide shot
panels.action: Rain pours down over Ha-Jun's crowned silhouette as steam hisses from the bisected monster's skull.
panels.prose_en: Rain pours down over Ha-Jun's crowned silhouette as steam hisses from the bisected monster's skull.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki tajposhi aakriti par baarish baras rahi hai aur do bhagon mein bante rakshas ki khopdi se bhaap nikal rahi hai.

panels.shot: min-jae dropping his plasma rifle in breathless joy
panels.action: Min-Jae drops his rifle, tears streaming behind his glasses: 'HA-JUN!! HE'S BACK!!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: HA-JUN WAPAS AA GAYA!! WITH THE CROWN!!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae drops his rifle, tears streaming behind his glasses: 'HA-JUN!! HE'S BACK!!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne apni rifle gira di, chashme ke peeche se aansu bah rahe the: 'Ha-Jun!! wah wapas aa gaya hai!!'

panels.shot: captain baek saluting with bloody combat glove
panels.action: Captain Baek wipes sweat and blood from his brow, exhaling in massive relief: 'The Sovereign has returned.'

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Hamare paas sirf 5 minute bache the... Timely arrival, Your Majesty.

panels.prose_en: Captain Baek wipes sweat and blood from his brow, exhaling in massive relief: 'The Sovereign has returned.'.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bak ne apne mathe se pasina aur khoon poncha aur badi rahat ki saans li: 'samprabhu wapas aa gaya hai.'

panels.shot: the 100-meter golden portal over gangnam flashing
panels.action: High above the intersection, the portal pulses violently as war horns sound from within.
panels.prose_en: High above the intersection, the portal pulses violently as war horns sound from within.
panels.prose_hi: Chaurahe ke upar, portal hinsak roop se dhadkata hai kyonki bhitar se yudh ke bhonpu bajte han.

panels.shot: general malgath and 50,000 iron demons pouring onto the streets
panels.action: The disciplined legions of iron demons flood the streets, forming impenetrable defensive shield-walls.
panels.prose_en: The disciplined legions of iron demons flood the streets, forming impenetrable defensive shield-walls.
panels.prose_hi: Lohe ke rakshason ki anushasit senayen sadkon par baadh laati han, jisse abhedy rakshatmak dhal-diwaren ban jaati han.

panels.shot: human citizens in buildings watching demons in stunned disbelief
panels.action: Civilians sheltered inside high-rise offices watch in amazement as demons fight alongside human hunters.

dialogue.text: Humanity ke itihaas mein pehli baar... Demons insaano ki dhaal ban kar khade the.

panels.prose_en: Civilians sheltered inside high-rise offices watch in amazement as demons fight alongside human hunters.
panels.prose_hi: Unchi imaaraton wale karyalayon ke andar sharan liye hue nagrik aashcharya se dekh rahe hain kyonki rakshas manav shikariyon ke saath lad rahe han.

panels.shot: malgath landing beside ha-jun bowing head
panels.action: Malgath strikes his chestplate: 'Sector 4 perimeter is locked, My Sovereign!'

dialogue.speaker: malgath
dialogue.text: Bahar ke saare beasts barricade ke peeche push kar diye gaye hain!

panels.prose_en: Malgath strikes his chestplate: 'Sector 4 perimeter is locked, My Sovereign!'.
panels.prose_hi: Malgath ne apni chestaplate par prahar kiya: 'secter 4 ki paridhi band hai, mere prabhu!'

panels.shot: ha-jun nodding: 'Good work, Malgath.'
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks down from the behemoth: 'Lekin invasion force ka commander kahan hai?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh mindless beasts hain. Inhe control kaun kar raha hai?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks down from the behemoth: 'Lekin invasion force ka commander kahan hai?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun rakshas se neeche dekhta hai: 'lakin aakraman bal ka commander kahan hai?'.

panels.shot: sudden drop in ambient light across seoul
panels.action: Every streetlamp and neon billboard in Gangnam flickers and dies; absolute unnatural pitch-darkness falls.
panels.prose_en: Every streetlamp and neon billboard in Gangnam flickers and dies; absolute unnatural pitch-darkness falls.
panels.prose_hi: Gangnam mein har street lamp aur neon billboard timtimata hai aur mar jata hai; bilkul aprakritik ghanghor andhera chha jata hai.

panels.shot: sky tearing open into a jagged black antimatter rift
panels.action: A three-hundred-meter vertical crack tears through the clouds, glowing with toxic green void energy.
panels.prose_en: A three-hundred-meter vertical crack tears through the clouds, glowing with toxic green void energy.
panels.prose_hi: Teen sau meter ki khadi daraar baadalon ko chirti hui jahrili hari shunya urja se chamakti hai.

panels.shot: a colossal floating throne of black bone descending
panels.action: Descending from the rift: a floating throne made of thousands of fused human and demon skulls.
panels.prose_en: Descending from the rift: a floating throne made of thousands of fused human and demon skulls.
panels.prose_hi: Darar se utarta hua: hajaron jude hue manav aur rakshas khopadiyon se bana ek tairta hua sinhasan.

panels.shot: void general xal'khor full design reveal
panels.action: Seated on the throne: an 18-foot biomechanical Void General with a faceless mirrored visor, six bladed arms, and void tentacles.
panels.prose_en: Seated on the throne: an 18-foot biomechanical Void General with a faceless mirrored visor, six bladed arms, and void tentacles.
panels.prose_hi: Sinhasan par baitha: ek 18 foot ka biomacanikal shunya janaral, jisme bina chehre wala darpan wala chhajja, chhah blade wali bhujaen aur shunya tambu han.

panels.shot: xal'khor voice vibrating in mechanical digital distortion
panels.action: A voice like grinding metal broadcast directly into everyone's skulls: 'The biological anomaly Ha-Jun Kang.'

dialogue.speaker: xal_khor
dialogue.text: Main Void Primordial ka High Arbiter hoon. Your universe has been selected for recycling.

panels.prose_en: A voice like grinding metal broadcast directly into everyone's skulls: 'The biological anomaly Ha-Jun Kang.'.
panels.prose_hi: Metal pisne jaisi awaz sidhe sabhi ki khopdi mein prasarit hoti hai: 'jaivik visangati Ha-Jun cong.'

panels.shot: xal'khor raising one mechanical blade arm
panels.action: Xal'Khor points at Ha-Jun's crown: 'The Sovereign Relics are obsolete technology. Hand them over.'
panels.prose_en: Xal'Khor points at Ha-Jun's crown: 'The Sovereign Relics are obsolete technology. Hand them over.'.
panels.prose_hi: Zaal'khor Ha-Jun ke mukut ki or ishara karte han: 'samprabhu avashesh aprachalit takneek han. unko saunp do.'.

panels.shot: ha-jun leaping off the dead behemoth to the asphalt
panels.action: Ha-Jun lands smoothly on the rain-slicked road, stepping toward the descending throne.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lands smoothly on the rain-slicked road, stepping toward the descending throne.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun baarish se sunny sadak par aasani se utarta hai, aur neeche ki or badhte hue sinhasan ki or badhta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun mocking the void general
panels.action: Ha-Jun smirks with icy disdain: 'Recycling? Tumhari vocabulary bohot advanced hai machine ke liye.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Lekin tumhare jaisi kitni machines ko maine pehle scrap banaya hai, pata hai?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smirks with icy disdain: 'Recycling? Tumhari vocabulary bohot advanced hai machine ke liye.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun barfile tiraskar se muskurata hai: 'punarchakran? tumhari shabdawali bahut unnat hai machine ke liye.'

panels.shot: xal'khor visor flashing crimson red
panels.action: The mirrored visor pulses angry red: 'Disrespect detected. Commencing biological purge.'
panels.prose_en: The mirrored visor pulses angry red: 'Disrespect detected. Commencing biological purge.'.
panels.prose_hi: Darpan ka chhajja gusse mein lal ho gaya: 'apman ka pata chala. jaivik shuddhikaran shuru ho raha hai.'

panels.shot: xal'khor launching six void antimatter missiles
panels.action: Six black spheres of pure antimatter launch from Xal'Khor's shoulders, homing in on Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_en: Six black spheres of pure antimatter launch from Xal'Khor's shoulders, homing in on Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_hi: Zaal'khor ke kandhon se shuddh antimatter ke chhah kale gole Ha-Jun ki or lautate hue launch hue.

panels.shot: ha-jun activating chains of ruin in midair
panels.action: Ha-Jun whips the Chains of Ruin; the black chains form a rotating gravitational shield in front of him.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun whips the Chains of Ruin; the black chains form a rotating gravitational shield in front of him.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun barbadi ki janjeeron ko kode maarta hai; kali janjeeren uske samne ek ghumti hui gurutvakarshan dhal banati han.

panels.shot: antimatter missiles detonating against the chains
panels.action: The six missiles detonate with terrifying white-hot flashes, but the gravity field absorbs 100% of the blast.
panels.prose_en: The six missiles detonate with terrifying white-hot flashes, but the gravity field absorbs 100% of the blast.
panels.prose_hi: Chhah missilen bhayanak safed-garm chamak ke saath visfot karti han, lekin gurutvakarshan kshetra visfot ka 100% avshoshit kar leta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing eclipse devourer through the smoke
panels.action: Ha-Jun bursts through the explosion smoke at Mach 2, the dark-matter greatsword raised overhead.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun bursts through the explosion smoke at Mach 2, the dark-matter greatsword raised overhead.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun mac 2 par visfot ke dhuen ke madhyam se futata hai, kale padarth wali mahan talwar upar ki or uthti hai.

panels.shot: xal'khor deploying six high-frequency energy blades
panels.action: Xal'Khor's six arms deploy humming green energy blades, meeting Ha-Jun's strike in midair.
panels.prose_en: Xal'Khor's six arms deploy humming green energy blades, meeting Ha-Jun's strike in midair.
panels.prose_hi: Zaal'khor ki chhah bhujaen gungunate hue harit urja blade tainat karti han, jo hawa mein Ha-Jun ke prahar ka samna karti han.

panels.shot: titanic midair deadlock between the two commanders
panels.action: Ha-Jun's single greatsword deadlocked against Xal'Khor's six energy blades; shockwaves rattle buildings.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's single greatsword deadlocked against Xal'Khor's six energy blades; shockwaves rattle buildings.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki ekal mahan talwar zaal'khor ke chhah urja bledon ke viruddh gatirodh mein thi; shockwaves imaaraton ko hila deti han.

panels.shot: xal'khor tentacles whipping around ha-jun ribs
panels.action: Four razor-tipped tentacles lash out from Xal'Khor's back, wrapping around Ha-Jun's ribs to crush him.
panels.prose_en: Four razor-tipped tentacles lash out from Xal'Khor's back, wrapping around Ha-Jun's ribs to crush him.
panels.prose_hi: Zaal'khor ki peeth se char ustra-nukile tambu nikalte han, jo use kuchalne ke liye Ha-Jun ki pasliyon ke charon or lapetate han.

panels.shot: ha-jun bone gauntlet and armor hardening instantly
panels.action: Ha-Jun's internal bone density activates; the crushing tentacles cannot compress his ribcage even an inch.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bone of the Forgotten... Tumhara hydraulic grip meri haddiyo ko touch bhi nahi kar sakta!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's internal bone density activates; the crushing tentacles cannot compress his ribcage even an inch.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki aantarik asthi ghanatv sakriya ho jaati hai; kuchalne wale sparshak uski pasli ko ek inch bhi nahin daba sakte.

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing the fang of abyss with left hand
panels.action: Ha-Jun pulls the void dagger with his left hand, slicing cleanly through all four tentacles in one reverse cut.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun pulls the void dagger with his left hand, slicing cleanly through all four tentacles in one reverse cut.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne baen haath se shunya khanjar khinchta hai, aur ek reverse cut mein sabhi char tentekals ko safai se kaatata hai.

panels.shot: xal'khor recoiling as black cybernetic fluid sprays
panels.action: Xal'Khor jerks backward, severed tentacle cables spewing green sparks and black coolant.
panels.prose_en: Xal'Khor jerks backward, severed tentacle cables spewing green sparks and black coolant.
panels.prose_hi: Zaal'khor peeche ki or jhatke maarta hai, tentekal cable cut jata hai aur hari chingari aur kala shitalak ugalta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun delivering downward heel kick to xal'khor chest
panels.action: Ha-Jun drives an axe-kick into Xal'Khor's chestplate, rocketing the 18-foot general into the street tarmac.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun drives an axe-kick into Xal'Khor's chestplate, rocketing the 18-foot general into the street tarmac.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne zaal'khor ke chestaplate mein ek kulhadi mari, jisse 18 foot ka general sadak par ja gira.

panels.shot: xal'khor crashing into gangnam intersection crater
panels.action: The Void General smashes into the asphalt, digging a 40-foot trench through the street.
panels.prose_en: The Void General smashes into the asphalt, digging a 40-foot trench through the street.
panels.prose_hi: Void general sadak par 40 foot ki khai khodkar damar ko tod deta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun hovering overhead with wings wide and sword drawn
panels.action: Ha-Jun hovers thirty feet above the smoking crater, pointing his greatsword down: 'Recycle this.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun hovers thirty feet above the smoking crater, pointing his greatsword down: 'Recycle this.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun dhumrapan gaddhe se tees feet upar mandarata hai, aur apni badi talwar ko neeche ki or ishara karta hai: 'ise recycle karen.'
